notes.title: Huntscape | Path of Life
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/2af19b3b152d8324deff80be4e295a9776163420.png
[hr][/hr]

Path of Life is a line of quests. By completing each quest as a Hunter or Prey you will receive a reward based on the chosen difficulty.

Each quest is different for the players' path. There are quests for the Hunters and quests for the Prey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/0af0559fc6bc300c001058b01bde9a55c1b85227.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/1af853e90a70953d75036e499b34299fa0c1c3a2.png
[hr][/hr]

While choosing the quest you will be given the chance to select a higher difficulty.

The higher difficulty means a more complicated mission but also a greater reward!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/a2fef66818a62bf94f855d9c5f288a8785042636.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/d6af96e36f27b2602ee20e6ad8e31d63f6f053ac.png

notes.title: Visual Update
notes.content:
Update
Main Menu


Added a completely new environment for the main menu, including wind, trees & bushes.


https://media.giphy.com/media/sWXCFWwnZbMBORGFjJ/giphy.gif



Update
Character Selection


Characters can now be rotated during the selection screen.


https://media.giphy.com/media/trCo9C6FImy71kDJ9a/giphy.gif



Update
Improved in-game visual quality & effects.


Improved lightning (mixed, baked with real-time).
Added environment effects - god rays and falling leaves
Added light reflection to selected objects
